instances.name: windows-local-bot1
instances._comment: Windows-only example. dir/launch_cmd use Windows paths/commands; stop_keys and session are tmux-only concepts and are ignored here. env (optional) sets explicit environment variables for the launch, replacing the login-shell env Linux's bash -lc sources implicitly. platform is reserved for a future per-instance override and isn't read anywhere yet -- the manager dispatches by host OS, not per instance.
